text:
Noor: Heads-up — several customers in the v2 rollout cohort reported unexpected quota hits billed to v1. Root cause: clients intermittently omit x-rw-version and our routing falls back to v1.
Ben: We made missing-header -> v1 the safe default ages ago. For rollouts that hurts customers.
Clara: Proposal: add a per-tenant console toggle `prefer_latest_on_missing` (opt-in). When enabled, missing headers should be treated as implicit v2 but with a probe weight.
Noor: Important: billing must show both requested_version (header) and routed_version so CS can explain differences. Don't silently reassign charges.
Ben: Implementation sketch: add request metadata fields `requested_version` (header or "-"), `routed_version`, `version_source` in {explicit_header, tenant_flag, global_default, probe}.
Clara: Safety nets: default probe_weight=25% for implicit->v2, sample N=1000 pairs for eval, and fallback_on_error that routes single failing request back to v1 and increments a rollback metric.
Noor: Also show a tenant badge with % headerless traffic and an estimate of potential v2 token delta if toggled to 100%.
dash-bot: Draft SQL for dashboard: SELECT tenant_id, sum(case when headers['x-rw-version'] is null then tokens else 0 end) as headerless_tokens, sum(tokens) as total_tokens FROM request_events WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY headerless_tokens DESC;
Ben: Ops quick fix: I can push a short-lived routing override for hit tenants (treat missing as v2 probe=30% window=30m) while we build console toggle. ops-bot, please record.
ops-bot: deploy: routing-override-for-hit-tenant started by Ben - probe_weight=30%, window=30m
Clara: I'll implement the telemetry tags and dashboard slice. Noor: I will draft console copy and the billing table changes for finance review.
Noor: Action items recap: Ben -> short-term override, Clara -> telemetry + dashboard, Noor -> console copy + billing UX, ops-bot -> record deploy. We'll monitor probe for 30m and then decide whether to ramp. Thanks.
